title: Material standards.
officialText:
Modified bitumen roof coverings shall comply with CGSB 37-GP-56M, ASTM D 6162, ASTM
D 6163, ASTM D 6164, ASTM D 6222, ASTM D 6223, ASTM D 6298 and ASTM D 6509.
